findings.rationale: Same fold as 89d5d9cf: opaque source_id, no path persisted; success criterion 4 extended to paths.

Same fold as a53b6048 (containment incl. intermediate directory links).

Folded §2 and criterion 5: wider-mode snapshot rewritten regardless of throttle; dirs tightened; db, -wal/-shm and dirs tightened after open with one stderr note; tests widen modes.
Folded §4 Incremental reads: only newline-terminated lines consumed, tail kept; buckets, dedup rows and cursor in one transaction; tests for a split record and an interrupted collect.
Folded §4 Replay and dedup: 35-day aggregation horizon below the 40-day dedup retention; Codex per-session-id highest counted cumulative (copies, replacement, decreases add nothing); tests listed.
Same fold as 48f18c67.

Folded §4: per-file state keyed by source_id = sha256(canonical path); path in memory only; privacy test seeds the project slug and parent dirs and asserts absence in db/wal/summary bytes.
Same fold as 7202cb7b.

Same fold as 716493df.

Same fold as 066f5e7e.
Same fold as 66270fbf, plus head = sha256(first 4 KiB) detects a same-inode shrink-and-regrow.
